newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgutneftegaz top bidder for Nafta-Moskva stake.
newsitem.headline: Surgutneftegaz top bidder for Nafta-Moskva stake.

text.p: Russian oil producer OAO Surgutneftegaz has made the highest bid at a tender for 14.99 percent of oil trader Nafta-Moskva, a privatisation source said on Thursday.
Surgutneftegaz is mostly owned by vertically integrated oil company Surgut Holding (NK Surgutneftegaz), Russia's third biggest oil producer.

The source, in the Russian Federal Property Fund which organised the tender, was unable to give details of the bid, as the fund has not yet officially confirmed the results of the tender, held on Wednesday.

The starting price for the packet of 124,401 shares, each with face value of 1,000 roubles, was 71 billion roubles. The winner also has to make investments in Nafta-Moskva totalling $6.0 million over three years.
